paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: The line plot, titled “INSPIRED,” illustrates how two performance metrics—Recall@50 and NDCG@50—change with respect to search depth, which ranges from 1 to 5 along the x-axis. The left y-axis, labeled “Recall@50,” spans from 0.3 to 0.6 in linear scale, while the right y-axis, labeled “NDCG@50,” ranges from 0.10 to 0.35, also linear. Four lines are plotted: a solid green line with circular markers represents “Recall@50 (Ours),” which rises from approximately 0.37 at depth 1 to 0.57 at depth 5; a green dotted line represents “Recall@50 (ReFICR),” which remains constant at 0.33 across all depths. A solid blue line with square markers represents “NDCG@50 (Ours),” increasing from about 0.22 at depth 1 to 0.25 at depth 5; and a blue dotted line represents “NDCG@50 (ReFICR),” which stays flat at 0.11. The plot includes a legend in the upper left and gridlines for reference, with the caption noting that ReFICR is included as a baseline for comparison.
